description: This file contains test fixture implementations for SharedMemoryBuffer, including setup, mapping/unmapping partitions, retrieving data lengths and offsets, clearing data, and accessing buffer pointers, primarily used for unit testing the SharedMemoryBuffer component.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing SharedMemoryBuffer functionalities, including initialization, mapping, data length retrieval, offset calculation, data clearing, and buffer access.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the shared memory buffer with specified maximum playbacks and web audio players.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that mapping a partition with given playback type and id succeeds.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that mapping a partition with given playback type and id fails.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a partition with given playback type and id succeeds.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a partition with given playback type and id fails.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of maximum data length for generic audio buffers.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies that requesting max data length for an unsupported playback type returns 0.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericVideoDataLen
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of maximum data length for generic video buffers.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxVideoDataLen
methods.description: Verifies that requesting max data length for an unsupported playback type returns 0.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxWebAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of maximum data length for web audio buffers.

methods.name: shouldReturnVideoDataOffset
methods.description: Checks that the data offset for video buffers matches expected value.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnVideoDataOffset
methods.description: Ensures that requesting data offset for unsupported playback type throws an exception.

methods.name: shouldReturnAudioDataOffset
methods.description: Checks that the data offset for audio buffers matches expected value.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnAudioDataOffset
methods.description: Ensures that requesting data offset for unsupported playback type throws an exception.

methods.name: shouldClearAudioData
methods.description: Verifies that clearing audio data returns true.

methods.name: shouldFailToClearAudioData
methods.description: Verifies that clearing audio data for unsupported playback type returns false.

methods.name: shouldClearVideoData
methods.description: Verifies that clearing video data returns true.

methods.name: shouldFailToClearVideoData
methods.description: Verifies that clearing video data for unsupported playback type returns false.

methods.name: shouldGetDataPtr
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to data for given playback type, id, and media source type.

methods.name: shouldFailToGetDataPtr
methods.description: Ensures that requesting data pointer for unsupported media source returns nullptr.

methods.name: shouldGetFd
methods.description: Checks that the file descriptor for the shared memory buffer is valid.

methods.name: shouldGetSize
methods.description: Verifies total size of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: shouldGetBuffer
methods.description: Checks that the buffer pointer is valid.
